format: cards: colour letter (R red, Y gold, G green, B blue, P purple) + number. Per hand: deal = hands by seat as dealt (sorted by colour, number); falls = first-fall card by seat; plays = every card in play order; legal = base-36 count of legal options per play decision; scores = hand score per seat. Game: kinds = Python bot kind by seat ('timed' | 'greedy' | 'random'); totals. Replay with firstDealer = n - 1; at every decision of a timed / greedy seat with more than one legal option the JS bot must choose the recorded card.
